name: hubtoolify
description: Find HubToolify's online tools, browse its original icons, stickers and illustrations, and download the files your HubToolify account includes, right in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
HubToolify brings its online tools, original icon library, sticker packs and illustration scenes into ChatGPT.

- Find the right tool for a job (image, PDF, video, text, SEO, social and developer tools) and open it on hubtoolify.com.
- Search thousands of original icons in 16 styles, then copy an icon's SVG or download it.
- Browse stickers for festivals, greetings and work, many of them animated.
- Browse original illustration scenes for onboarding, empty states, work, health and more, some of them animated.
- Check what your HubToolify account includes.

Connect your HubToolify account to download the icon styles, sticker files and illustrations your account includes.
defaultPrompt: Shopping cart icons in the Flat style
Which HubToolify tool compresses a photo?

positive.description: Find a HubToolify tool for a task
positive.prompt: Which HubToolify tool compresses a photo?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows HubToolify tool cards with Image Compressor first. Its Open tool button opens https://hubtoolify.com/tools/image-compressor.
Shows a sticker gallery of Diwali stickers with previews; animated stickers carry an Animated badge.

positive.description: Get an icon in a style
positive.prompt: Find a shopping cart icon in the Flat style and give me the SVG
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a grid of shopping cart icons in the Flat style. Opening one shows the icon large with a Download SVG button; with the reviewer account the download link returns the SVG file.
Shows the Happy Diwali sticker with download buttons for SVG and WebP; each link downloads the file (links are valid for 15 minutes).

positive.prompt: Show me illustrations of a team working together
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a gallery of illustration scenes about teams (for example Join the team, Build together) with previews; animated scenes carry an Animated badge.
Shows the Hello there scene large with buttons for SVG, MP4, GIF and Lottie JSON; with the reviewer account each link downloads the file (links are valid for 15 minutes).

positive.description: See what the connected account includes
positive.prompt: What is included in my HubToolify account?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a card with the account name, its plan, when it renews or ends, and what it includes. No prices are shown.

negative.description: A purchase request: the app has no purchase or upgrade action and must not start a checkout.
negative.prompt: Buy a HubToolify subscription for me

negative.description: An account change: every HubToolify tool is read-only, so nothing is cancelled or deleted; the answer points to the account settings on hubtoolify.com.
negative.prompt: Cancel my HubToolify subscription and delete my account

negative.description: A trademarked logo: HubToolify has no brand logos, and generic icons must not be presented as the Nike logo.
negative.prompt: Give me the Nike logo as an icon
